title: Update!!!!
text: Update!!!!. This rice cooker broke after the third time I used it. When it did work it was good but I bought 2 and they both broke within the 3rd use :(

product_metadata.title: Hello Kitty Rice Cooker - Pink (APP-43209)
description: Make rice anytime, anywhere with the Hello Kitty Rice Cooker. This appliance takes all the guesswork out of cooking rice. No more standing over a hot stove: all you need to do is hit one button. The machine will sense once the rice is cooked to fluffy perfection and switch automatically from cooking mode to warming mode. Your rice will be kept hot and moist for whenever you are ready to eat it. Cleaning is also easy with the removable, non-stick, inner cooking pot. This easy to operate cooker is great for all houses, apartments, and dorm rooms.
